content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-40. - Time of increase in contribution.
content.summary:
The increase in contribution from 7.75 percent to 8.05 percent and the computation
               of refunds shall take effect January 1, 1978, notwithstanding the effective date of
               this chapter.
(Code 1960, § 19-18(E); Code 1981, § 26-10)
